# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 30 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Seth Returns; Adam Prepares for Death

---

**1** When Seth returned, Adam was close to death.

**2** 'Did you get the oil of mercy, my son?' Adam asked. 'No, father,' Seth said. 'Michael the archangel said it is kept for a future time.'

**3** Adam was comforted. 'Then God has not forgotten me. He has promised me mercy.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
